name: Blackness
overview: The biblical concept of blackness appears primarily in a figurative sense, representing intense suffering, shame, and judgment. Job describes physical affliction with his skin blackened by heat, while Joel portrays the distress of people whose faces gather blackness in fear. Jude uses the phrase 'blackness of darkness' to depict eternal condemnation reserved for the ungodly, emphasizing a profound spiritual darkness beyond mere physical appearance.
